change: Two additions from the ChatGPT mockup, adapted to fit the real app: (1) Vertical status timeline (Reported -> Attended -> In Progress -> Resolved) at the top of the Edit Breakdown modal, dark dispatch-console styled with checkmarks and timestamps. Attended/In Progress are auto-stamped the first time a mechanic gets assigned / Work Done gets filled in, never overwritten once set. (2) A 4-card colorful stat strip (Total Jobs Today / In Progress Active / Resolved Today / Avg Resolution Today) above the Breakdown Register, computed live from breakdown data.
